purpose: Single-file source-grounded DBM-CoA integration bundle for all documented Vanilla dungeons
verification: All timings are candidates; no live realm verification
rules: Use all 19 map encounter rosters for source-grounded NPC detection, not guaranteed live spawns
Source kit/SmartAI actions include nonspell and noncombat rows; never treat all as boss timers
Only cast events with supported initial and repeat values can drive predictive bars
Difficulty, targeting, cast flags and event phase fields from rawSourceFields must be applied
Provisional rows have inferred map assignments; avoid treating Chromatic Elite Guard as boss
C++ schedules require event-to-spell resolution before enabling bars
Avoid duplicates with AutoLearner; keep live observations distinct from source definitions
The presence of a pending SQL file is not evidence that it is deployed on Conquest Reborn
